press_references.value: Robinhood seeks to dismiss lawsuit brought by Indian tribes in California

legal_proceedings.description: Robinhood Markets, joined by Robinhood Derivatives, moved to dismiss a lawsuit filed by Blue Lake Rancheria, Chicken Ranch Rancheria of Me‑Wuk Indians, and Picayune Rancheria of the Chukchansi Indians alleging illegal sports gambling on tribal lands. A hearing on the motion is set for March 19, 2026 before Judge Jacqueline Scott Corley. Robinhood argues IGRA claims don’t apply, CFTC/CEA jurisdiction controls event contracts, and UIGEA exempts its activities, and challenges tribal and RICO claims.
